A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction parts
skills.definition: Make fraction parts directly comparable for subtraction by recognizing a shared denominator or finding an LCD and converting equivalent fractions.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are rewritten as equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten with a fractional part such as 0/5 or 0/8 so the fraction parts share a denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have matching denominators and no rewriting or denominator work is shown.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless the step also serves to equalize denominators.
Do not tag pure subtraction or simplification steps.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number or whole number into a standard mixed-number structure before subtracting, especially when a mixed number has an improper fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is explicitly rewritten as a mixed number with zero fractional part to fit the mixed-number subtraction setup.
Tag when the step reorganizes a quantity into whole and fraction parts before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator conversion among proper fractions; that belongs to common-denominator work.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction; that is regrouping.
Do not tag final combining or simplification.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract the relevant numerators, whole parts, and/or fraction parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of like-denominator fractions.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole-number parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers.
Tag when the solution performs the main subtraction after any needed normalization or denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is only to create common denominators or rewrite forms.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fraction parts after a negative fraction result appears.
Do not tag simplification-only steps.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve subtraction results that require borrowing between whole and fractional parts and express the final answer in lowest terms or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part to continue fraction subtraction.
Tag when the solution converts results such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the solution combines the final whole and fractional parts into the reported answer after regrouping or simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not involve regrouping or reduction.
Do not tag initial rewriting to common denominators or normalization.
Do not tag combining alone if no simplification or regrouping is involved.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction parts
skills.definition: Make fraction parts directly comparable for subtraction by using a common denominator or recognizing that the denominators already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD or common denominator before subtracting fraction parts.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solver explicitly treats same-denominator fraction parts as ready for direct subtraction in a mixed-number problem.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the item already involves only whole-number subtraction with no fraction part to align.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless the step also equalizes denominators.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping; that is a separate operation.

skills.name: Rewrite composite numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a 0-fraction part or normalizing a mixed number with an improper fraction part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a fraction with numerator 0, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2.
Tag when a step explicitly decomposes a mixed number into whole and fraction parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding a common denominator or converting equivalent fractions; that belongs to equalizing fraction parts.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag the final recombination of whole and fraction parts into the answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction once the quantities are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators for like fractions and subtracting whole and fraction parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solver subtracts whole parts and fraction parts in a mixed-number or whole-number expression.
Tag when the solver performs the main subtraction after any needed rewriting or denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fractional parts after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve subtraction results that need adjustment by borrowing/regrouping and express the final result in lowest terms or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole part to make the fractional subtraction possible.
Tag when the solver converts a negative fractional part into a valid mixed-number result through regrouping.
Tag when the solver reduces a fraction to lowest terms or simplifies a zero fraction to an integer.
Tag when the solver combines the adjusted whole and fraction parts into the final simplified answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that is composite-number rewriting.
Do not tag finding an LCD or making equivalent fractions.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction that requires no regrouping or simplification beyond the raw difference.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities so the fractional parts are in a compatible form for subtraction, including finding a common denominator or expressing a whole number with a zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n to align with a fractional or mixed-number form.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are explicitly rewritten to share a denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting/alignment is performed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2; that is S02.
Do not tag the actual subtraction or borrowing steps; those are S03 or S04.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 5/3 is rewritten as an equivalent mixed number with a proper fractional part.
Tag when the solver explicitly states 'normalize' and changes the whole and fractional parts accordingly.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions; those are S01.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/n; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction; that is S04.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and/or subtracting whole parts and fraction parts separately, then combining the result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like-denominator fractions are subtracted by subtracting numerators.
Tag when mixed-number subtraction is done by subtracting whole parts and fraction parts without borrowing.
Tag when the solver combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or integer, provided no borrowing operation is the focus of the step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator-finding or rewriting steps; those are S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that is S02.
Do not tag any step whose key operation is borrowing/regrouping because the fractional part would otherwise be negative; that is S04.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into n/n fractional units.
Tag when the solver first gets a negative fractional difference and then regroups to complete the subtraction.
Tag when borrowing is used in mixed-minus-mixed, whole-minus-fraction, or mixed-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction that does not require regrouping; that is S03.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion or rewriting a whole as 0/n before any borrowing; that is S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that is S02.
